images.subject: A prototype energy core: one upright glass-walled cylinder holding a bright contained sphere of pure energy.
images.detail: Thin controlled electric arcs link the sphere to the heavy metal collar around it.

images.subject: A prototype laser cannon mounted on a heavy pedestal.
images.detail: It fires one thin straight continuous beam onto a small metal target plate, which glows where the beam hits it.

images.subject: A prototype ion accelerator: one long straight open tube of magnetic coils.
images.detail: A narrow stream of glowing ions flows along its axis and out of its muzzle.

images.subject: A prototype plasma containment ring: one large metal torus with an open inner channel.
images.detail: A twisting filament of plasma circles inside the channel without touching its walls.

images.subject: A prototype computing core made of a tight cluster of tall luminous columns.
images.detail: Bundles of fine glowing optical fibres run between the columns.

images.subject: A prototype stealth reconnaissance probe: a small matte black angular drone held in a test cradle.
images.detail: Its single large sensor lens glows and sweeps a thin fan of scanning light across the bench.

images.subject: A prototype heavy kinetic cannon on a reinforced mount.
images.detail: A thick steel target plate in front of it is riddled with smoking impact holes, glowing at their edges.

images.subject: A prototype shield generator: one compact machine projecting a translucent dome of force field over itself.
images.detail: An incoming energy bolt bursts into ripples against the surface of the dome.

images.subject: A massive hydraulic press testing one thick prototype armour plate.
images.detail: The plate holds under the press, its edges glowing with heat.

images.subject: A prototype chemical rocket engine with one large bell nozzle, mounted horizontally on a test stand.
images.detail: A long roaring flame shoots out of the nozzle.

images.subject: A prototype impulse engine built from a row of concentric metal rings, mounted horizontally on a test stand.
images.detail: A pulsing shockwave of light expands out of the rings.

images.subject: A prototype hyperspace drive: one huge upright metal ring standing on the test bench.
images.detail: Inside the ring, space itself is warped: light bends into a swirling lens and the hall behind it appears distorted.
